name: Yofuke Rei
source:
A fashion model who has an affair every night with a man with a wife and children. Slender and beautiful looking, she always makes sure to keep her nails beautiful. She demands that her affair partner divorce his wife, and feels gloomy due to him refusing to do so. She's usually calm and collected, but can get more talkative when excited.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2022/11/11/yona/]official site[/url]]
